name: healthaccess
description: Health Access MCP: Apple Health and Apple Watch workouts for Claude, from files on your own computer.

plugins.name: healthaccess-mcp
plugins.description: Reads the folder the Health Access iPhone app writes (workouts, daily health data, a one-page briefing) and puts workout plans back on the Apple Watch. A local MCP server started with npx, plus eleven prompts as skills.
